label: Development
p0: Recognizing individual human faces by their specific features.
p1: Forming the abstract general concept of a 'human face'.
emergence_rationale: Encountering many individual faces leads to extracting their common abstract structure.
potential_rationale: The general concept of a face is implicit in the ability to recognize individual faces.
determinacy_rationale: The general concept clarifies what essential features define a face, making the initial recognition more determinate.

label: Development
p0: Hardcoding three different if-else statements for payment methods.
p1: Refactoring the payment logic into a generic Strategy design pattern.
emergence_rationale: Adding more payment methods makes the if-else chain unmaintainable, demanding a formal abstraction.
potential_rationale: The generic strategy interface is the implicit structural logic that the if-else chain was attempting to express.
determinacy_rationale: The Strategy pattern explicitly formalizes the distinct payment behaviors that were tangled in the if-else statements.

label: Workflow
p0: Putting dirty clothes into the washing machine.
p1: Pressing the start button on the washing machine.
emergence_rationale: The machine must be loaded before it can be started.
potential_rationale: Pressing start is an external mechanical trigger, not an implicit logical development of putting clothes in.
determinacy_rationale: Pressing start initiates the wash but does not conceptually develop the act of loading clothes.

label: Workflow
p0: Checking out the source code from the git repository.
p1: Running the 'npm install' command to download dependencies.
emergence_rationale: The code must be present locally before dependencies can be installed.
potential_rationale: Installing dependencies is a sequential external step required by the package manager.
determinacy_rationale: Running npm install does not conceptually clarify the act of checking out code.

label: Alternative
p0: Sending data to the server using a REST API.
p1: Sending data to the server using a GraphQL API.
emergence_rationale: The team decided to switch protocols for more flexible querying.
potential_rationale: GraphQL is a replacement technology for REST, not a logical development out of it.
determinacy_rationale: Switching protocols is just an alternative implementation.

label: Alternative
p0: Eating the soup with a wooden spoon.
p1: Eating the soup with a metal spoon.
emergence_rationale: The wooden spoon broke, so a metal one was used.
potential_rationale: A metal spoon performs the exact same function as a wooden spoon.
determinacy_rationale: It provides no new conceptual determination, merely a different material.
